::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/webhook_endpoints/{id}/rotate_secret"}
#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | **yes** | The webhook endpoint's id. |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `id` | `string` | The webhook endpoint's id (whe_…). |
| `url` | `string` | The URL that receives the webhooks. |
| `business` | `string` | Business scope; null = receives all of the org’s events in this endpoint’s partition. |
| `livemode` | `string` | The endpoint's partition. An endpoint only ever receives events from businesses in its own partition; org-level events (no business) reach both. Immutable. One of `test`, `live`. |
| `signing_secret` | `string` | Returned once at creation; verify deliveries with HMAC-SHA256. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | Whether the endpoint receives webhooks. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such endpoint |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/webhook_endpoints/whe_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/rotate_secret" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)"
```
